report.summary: Claim 15.2 requires 'explicit repository-owner approval' but the document never defines who the repository owner is or how to authenticate them; this makes the entire amendment protocol unenforceable.
risks: 15.2 | critical | 'Obtain explicit repository-owner approval' - the document never defines 'repository owner' or any authentication mechanism for that role, so the requirement is unenforceable. | Show any section that defines repository owner identity or authentication; none exists.

15.1 | medium | 'Ordinary tasks must not edit the plan...' - The document does not define what constitutes an 'ordinary task' vs an amendment task, creating ambiguity. | Check if 'ordinary task' is defined elsewhere; it is not.

15.3 | low | 'Start the amendment session with DAEDALUS_IRON_PLAN_AMENDMENT=<current full plan sha256>' - This environment variable is not defined or mentioned elsewhere in the document; its purpose and origin are unclear. | Search the document for any definition or use of DAEDALUS_IRON_PLAN_AMENDMENT.

15.7 | low | 'Run policy verification and the relevant fault-injection suite' - The document does not specify what 'policy verification' or 'fault-injection suite' are or how to invoke them. | Look for any section describing policy verification or fault injection; none found.
todos: Define 'repository owner' and specify how their approval is authenticated and recorded.
Define 'ordinary task' to distinguish it from amendment tasks.
Define or reference the DAEDALUS_IRON_PLAN_AMENDMENT environment variable.
Specify what 'policy verification' and 'fault-injection suite' consist of and how they are run.
